verdict.rationale: Vanta's audit product says it helps you "collaborate seamlessly with auditors." Its Auditor API lets an audit firm conduct audits in Vanta: it lists the audits assigned to that firm, pulls controls and evidence, manages information requests (IRLs), and reviews the resources and personnel in scope for each engagement. Together these show auditors working in the platform, scoped per engagement, rather than trading PDFs by email. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the auditor-facing UI and its permission scoping (the evidence centres on the API), and independent or hands-on confirmation that auditors actually work this way in practice.
